summary: Tested the new AI-suggestion (user_note) feature on /meals/generate and /workouts/generate (backend) + the new AISuggestionModal bottom-sheet wired into the Meals and Workouts tabs (frontend). Backend: 8/8 pytest tests pass in /app/backend/tests/test_ai_suggestion.py — note influence verified for meals (protein keywords appear), upper-body intent honored for workouts (push/pull/row/press in plan, no jumping/burpees), Sunday-rest non-override verified even with 'heavy lifting 1 hr PR attempts' note (returned gentle session ≤45 min with stretch/walk/rest/prayer language), backward compat without user_note works on both endpoints, and different notes produce different plans (note_hash properly folded into LLM session_id). Frontend: end-to-end happy paths verified on a mobile (390x844) viewport using a seeded session token — modal slide-up, multiline input, character counter (28/600 then 600 cap when pasting 700 chars), QUICK IDEAS chips replace input, submit disabled when empty/whitespace-only, submit closes modal and triggers generation, applied-note pill renders the user's note above Regenerate on both tabs, tapping the pill reopens the modal pre-filled, X icon and Cancel button both dismiss the modal, X-in-pill clears the note. Workouts empty-state link 'Tell the AI what to focus on' opens the same modal. No critical issues, no regressions.

backend.POST /api/meals/generate (with user_note: 200, plan shape OK, protein keywords in output — PASS
backend.POST /api/workouts/generate (upper-body: 200, exercises mention push/pull/row/press; no jump/burpee — PASS
backend.note_hash folded into session_id: Same date + different notes → different plans — PASS

critical_code_review_comments: server.py:402,470 — `note_hash = sha1(note_clean)[:8] if note_clean else 'none'` is a clean way to keep cache-busting per-note without leaking the raw note into the session_id. Good.
server.py:383,448 — note_clean is `.strip()[:600]` BEFORE the prompt and BEFORE hashing, so 'foo' and ' foo  ' map to the same note_hash → consistent. Confirmed.
server.py:5 — `import hashlib` is now present at module top (line 5); previous F821 undefined-name bug on meal generation when a note was supplied is fixed.

AISuggestionModal.tsx:50 — `canSubmit = trimmed.length > 0 && !submitting` — correctly blocks whitespace-only submits and double-submits during pending generation. UI aria-disabled=true verified in DOM.

AISuggestionModal.tsx:102 — `onChangeText={(t) => setText(t.slice(0, MAX_LEN))}` clamps at 600 even when the user pastes longer content. Verified end-to-end (paste 700 chars → input.value.length === 600).

meals.tsx:317 / workouts.tsx:353 — `initialValue={notes[selected] || ''}` makes the modal idempotent across re-opens and date switches; combined with the `useEffect([visible, initialValue])` reset inside the modal, the prefill works on reopen.

Non-blocking suggestion: the applied-note pill currently lives only in-memory (`useState`) and is dropped on app reload. If the product wants the note to survive reload, the note could be persisted to the meal/workout doc (e.g. add `user_note` to the saved doc and re-hydrate `notes[selected]` from the loaded plan).
